ruleDefinitions.name: Operator Bloopers Cobalt Strike Commands
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects use of Cobalt Strike commands accidentally entered in the CMD shell

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX("^cmd\\ ") OR process_command_line = RGX("^cmd\\\.exe") OR process_command_line = RGX("^c\\:\\\\windows\\\\system32\\\\cmd\\\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*psinject.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*spawnas.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*make\\_token.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*remote\\-exec.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rev2self.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dcsync.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*logonpasswords.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*execute\\-assembly.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*getsystem.*"))))
